verdict.rationale: Sardine documents a Case Management workspace for reviewing alerts, investigating and resolving cases. For sanctions screening, it says AI agents route higher-risk matches to analyst review and escalate real exposure. That covers the review-and-escalation part, but nothing shows operations leads assigning cases or configuring multi-stage workflows. missing for 10: case assignment to analysts or queues, configurable review and escalation stages in case management, routing beyond sanctions screening, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a operations-lead, I can assign cases and route them through analyst review and escalation stages

citations.quote: Case Management: Unified workspace to review alerts, conduct investigations, and resolve cases.
AI agents clear obvious false positives, perform supporting research, and route higher-risk matches for analyst review.
Auto-clear low-risk matches and escalate real exposure with explainable scores.
